s: Hatmanat chammin beereb yom kippur ubo seip echad: yesh oserim lehatmin chammin meereb yom kippur lemotzae yom hakkippurim, mippene shello hittiru lehatmin chammin ella likbod hashshabbat, abal zeh shehu matmin lemotzae yom hakkippurim shehu chol — lo hittiru lo kelal, lepi shehattabshil mitchammem beyom hakkippurim, venimtza yom hakkippurim mekin lechol. Veyesh mattirim lehatmin beereb yom kippur, mippene shehu mekin mechol lechol, veap al pi sheshshoheh al hakkira beyom hakkippurim — en zo chashuba hakana, kevan sheeno oseh maaseh beyom hakkippurim. Vahalaka kassebara haacharona. Mikkol maqom, nohagin beellu hammedinot lehachamir kassebara harishona:
